mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE u AS ( SELECT user_seq, dept_seq FROM adm_user_mst WHERE login_id = #{user_id} AND use_yn = 'Y' ), user_groups AS ( SELECT agu.auth_group_seq FROM adm_auth_group_user agu JOIN u ON u.user_seq = agu.user_seq WHERE agu.use_yn = 'Y' UNION SELECT agd.auth_group_seq FROM adm_auth_group_dept agd JOIN u ON u.dept_seq = agd.dept_seq WHERE agd.use_yn = 'Y' ), base_perm AS ( SELECT aam.menu_seq, MAX(COALESCE(aam.perm_lvl, 0)) AS base_perm_lvl FROM adm_auth_menu aam JOIN user_groups ug ON ug.auth_group_seq = aam.auth_group_seq WHERE aam.use_yn = 'Y' GROUP BY aam.menu_seq ), user_deny AS ( SELECT au.menu_seq FROM adm_auth_user au JOIN u ON u.user_seq = au.user_seq WHERE au.access_yn = 'X' ), user_allow AS ( SELECT au.menu_seq, MAX(COALESCE(au.perm_lvl, 0)) AS allow_perm_lvl FROM adm_auth_user au JOIN u ON u.user_seq = au.user_seq WHERE au.access_yn = 'Y' GROUP BY au.menu_seq ), final_self AS ( SELECT m.menu_seq, CASE WHEN d.menu_seq IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(b.base_perm_lvl, 0), COALESCE(a.allow_perm_lvl, 0)) END AS final_perm_lvl FROM adm_menu_mst m LEFT JOIN base_perm b ON b.menu_seq = m.menu_seq LEFT JOIN user_allow a ON a.menu_seq = m.menu_seq LEFT JOIN user_deny d ON d.menu_seq = m.menu_seq WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' ), deny_tree AS ( SELECT DISTINCT menu_seq FROM user_deny UNION SELECT c.menu_seq FROM adm_menu_mst c JOIN deny_tree d ON d.menu_seq = c.up_menu_seq WHERE c.use_yn = 'Y' ), allowed_leaf AS ( SELECT fs.menu_seq FROM final_self fs WHERE fs.final_perm_lvl > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deny_tree d WHERE d.menu_seq = fs.menu_seq) ), allowed_with_parents(menu_seq, up_menu_seq) AS ( SELECT m.menu_seq, m.up_menu_seq FROM adm_menu_mst m JOIN allowed_leaf al ON al.menu_seq = m.menu_seq WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' UNION SELECT p.menu_seq, p.up_menu_seq FROM adm_menu_mst p JOIN allowed_with_parents awp ON awp.up_menu_seq = p.menu_seq WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' ), included_menu AS ( SELECT DISTINCT awp.menu_seq FROM allowed_with_parents awp WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deny_tree d WHERE d.menu_seq = awp.menu_seq) ) SELECT m.menu_seq AS menu_seq, m.menu_nm AS menu_nm, m.menu_url AS menu_url, m.icon_class AS icon_class, m.up_menu_seq AS up_menu_seq, m.sort_ord AS sort_no, CASE WHEN COALESCE(fs.final_perm_lvl, 0) > 0 THEN fs.final_perm_lvl ELSE 1 END AS perm_lvl FROM adm_menu_mst m JOIN included_menu im ON im.menu_seq = m.menu_seq LEFT JOIN final_self fs ON fs.menu_seq = m.menu_seq WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY COALESCE(m.up_menu_seq, 0), m.sort_ord, m.menu_seq

WITH RECURSIVE base_perm AS ( SELECT aam.menu_seq, MAX(COALESCE(aam.perm_lvl, 0)) AS base_perm_lvl FROM adm_auth_menu aam WHERE aam.auth_group_seq = #{auth_group_seq} AND aam.use_yn = 'Y' GROUP BY aam.menu_seq ), allowed_leaf AS ( SELECT bp.menu_seq FROM base_perm bp WHERE bp.base_perm_lvl > 0 ), allowed_with_parents(menu_seq, up_menu_seq) AS ( SELECT m.menu_seq, m.up_menu_seq FROM adm_menu_mst m JOIN allowed_leaf al ON al.menu_seq = m.menu_seq WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' UNION SELECT p.menu_seq, p.up_menu_seq FROM adm_menu_mst p JOIN allowed_with_parents awp ON awp.up_menu_seq = p.menu_seq WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' ) SELECT m.menu_seq AS menu_seq, m.menu_nm AS menu_nm, m.menu_url AS menu_url, m.icon_class AS icon_class, m.up_menu_seq AS up_menu_seq, m.sort_ord AS sort_no, CASE WHEN COALESCE(bp.base_perm_lvl, 0) > 0 THEN bp.base_perm_lvl ELSE 1 END AS perm_lvl FROM adm_menu_mst m JOIN allowed_with_parents awp ON awp.menu_seq = m.menu_seq LEFT JOIN base_perm bp ON bp.menu_seq = m.menu_seq WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY COALESCE(m.up_menu_seq, 0), m.sort_ord, m.menu_seq

SELECT menu_seq AS menu_seq, up_menu_seq AS up_menu_seq, menu_nm AS menu_nm, menu_url AS menu_url, menu_type_cd AS menu_type_cd, icon_class AS icon_class, sort_ord AS sort_no, use_yn AS use_yn FROM adm_menu_mst WHERE menu_seq = #{menuSeq}
